CW added lines to get dates in necessary format
```{r}
dates <- dates %>%
  # keep pt id, irAE, and microbiome days
  select(`Patient Id`, sample_id, irAE, Baseline, Control, AE, `12wk`) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(`Patient Id`, sample_id, irAE), names_to = "Timepoint", values_to = "Microbiome.days")
```

```{r}
#spread(dates,'Patient ID', key=Timepoint, value=Days)

```

# number of days from when we received a microbiome sample at an irae occurence
```{r}

sublist <- 
  dates %>% 
  mutate(days.from.irae = Microbiome.days - irAE) %>% 
  drop_na(days.from.irae) 
  
sublist$sample_id <- gsub(".2", ".1", sublist$sample_id)

output <- sublist %>% unique()


```

```{r}



ggplot(output, aes(x=days.from.irae)) + geom_histogram()



```
#adding timepoints

```{r}

#define window size that will be tested
window <-seq(1,max(abs(output$days.from.irae )))
#pre-allocate memory to store for loop output
out <- data.frame(windowsize = window, qty = NA)


for (i in window) { 
  window.test <- abs(output$days.from.irae) < i
  
  out$qty[i] <- sum(window.test) 
}
head(out)
```


```{r}

out %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=windowsize, y = qty)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Window Size",
       y = "Quantity")

ggsave(file = "../figures/irae_windowsize.png", width = 4, height = 3)
```

```{r}
out %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=windowsize, y = qty)) +
  geom_line() + 
  xlim(0,15) +
  ylim(0,15)

#ggsave(file = "../figures/irae_windowsize_closeup.png", dev = "png", width = 10, height = 7)

```


```{r}
out %>% 
  filter(windowsize == 12)
```

```{r}

out.sign <- data.frame(windowsize = window,
                       qty = NA,
                       before.or.after = NA)

for (i in window) { 
  window.test <- abs(sublist$days.from.irae) < i
  
  out.sign$qty[i] <- sum(window.test) 

  }


```
